gemma-small-big-fr#838e89f8.summary: Almost every member detects French text specifically — common French words, question words, verb conjugations, accented characters — and a large fraction narrows that to French-language online discussion of computers, Ubuntu/Linux and software problems, with a few code-snippet detectors mixed in. This is the group that establishes 'this prompt is French' at the very start of the network.

gemma-small-big-fr#d2ec42b2.summary: The dominant concept is physical/abstract size: features for the words 'small', 'little', 'big', 'grand', 'large', 'too/sufficiently', plus adjectives of size, quantity and importance, measurements and comparisons. Several late-layer members push toward the 'big' answer while earlier ones represent the 'petit' input.

gemma-small-big-fr#c564eba8.summary: Two intertwined threads: features for quotation marks and quoted spans of text (double quotes, single quotes, text within quotes, quotes plus surrounding words), and features for code and markup — JavaScript snippets, import statements, documentation blocks, curly brackets, programming/legal/scientific jargon. Essentially a punctuation-and-syntax scaffolding group for the quoted-answer format.

gemma-small-big-fr#c9f45ff8.summary: A near-identical size-comparison cluster: the words 'small', 'little', 'big' and 'grand', size and quantity adjectives, diminutive word forms, less-than/greater-than symbols, and measurement or threshold language. A handful of noisier members cover size in financial or mathematical framing.

gemma-small-big-fr#ae506fa5.summary: Members overwhelmingly encode size and scale words — 'small'/'little' on one side, 'big'/'large'/'grand' on the other — along with diminutives, size adjectives, measurements, and mathematical size thresholds. Content mirrors the other size clusters for this antonym prompt.

gemma-small-big-fr#aa0e148b.summary: A low-layer grab-bag dominated by legal and technical document vocabulary (names of laws, legal terms, abbreviations), programming code and file-path strings, code comments, and quoted strings, with a scattering of generic-noun and French copula ('est') detectors. No single semantic thread beyond 'formal technical/legal text'.

gemma-small-big-fr#5b1c09f7.summary: Another size-semantics cluster: the words 'small', 'little', 'big', 'grand', diminutive forms, adjectives of size and importance, quantity words, measurement and comparison language, and inequality symbols. A few outliers touch on size in financial or math-jargon contexts.

gemma-small-big-fr#f39c5946.summary: The unifying idea is contrast and inversion: 'vice versa', 'inverse', 'reverse', words indicating disagreement or contradiction, things being opposite or contrary, plus equivalence/counterpart and symmetry terms. Secondary strands are word-definition/etymology features and mathematical notation for duals and transposes, all triggered around the French words 'contraire', 'de' and 'est'.

gemma-small-big-fr#ea23aad0.summary: Mixes three recognizable strands: word meaning and definition features (etymology, grammar/language terms, 'words that define concepts'), quotation-mark and quoted-text features, and code/markup features (JavaScript, documentation blocks, programming keywords). A couple of odd members detect profanity or political figures.

gemma-small-big-fr#9fddafcc.summary: Chiefly quotation-mark and quoted-span detectors together with code, markup and documentation features (import statements, JavaScript, programming keywords, curly brackets), plus a few members for definitions of names or phrases and for conjunctions/quantifiers. Reads as format scaffolding rather than a content topic.

gemma-small-big-fr#6198e508.summary: An early-layer set built around formal document language: legal and technical terms and abbreviations, software code and file-path strings, code comments and import statements, and quoted strings. Remaining members are generic-noun or section-header detectors with no shared topic.

gemma-small-big-fr#5020cd69.summary: Two main strands: verb features centered on 'to be' — the word 'is', conjugated forms across languages, auxiliary and multilingual verb detectors, plus French articles like 'le/la/un' — and software boilerplate features for 'assembly/using/namespace/license', licensing and import snippets, and LaTeX/markup syntax. Several one-off detectors (the surname 'Lee', the word 'apparently') make it partly a grab-bag.

gemma-small-big-fr#7ddc3585.summary: Quoted-text features (double and single quotes, text within quotes, quotes plus adjacent words) combined with code and documentation features (JavaScript snippets, import statements, copyright/doc blocks, programming and markup keywords). Same punctuation-and-syntax scaffolding as the other quote clusters on this prompt.

gemma-small-big-fr#fd70d02b.summary: An input-layer grab-bag whose largest threads are proper nouns (names of people and places, surnames), abbreviations and short prefixes in legal or medical writing, and technical/code tokens such as LaTeX, protobuf and math acronyms. A recurring member type detects bracketed percentage data in lab or medical reports.

gemma-small-big-fr#8d069f37.summary: Mostly code-adjacent tokens: 'assembly/using/namespace/license' terms, licensing and import snippets, LaTeX and markup, programming errors and math acronyms, alongside abbreviations and short legal or medical word fragments. A few multilingual verb and one-off word detectors round it out.

gemma-small-big-fr#66cf1e60.summary: Input-layer features for abbreviations and word fragments, proper nouns naming people and places, technical/code tokens (LaTeX, protobuf, math acronyms), and repeatedly for bracketed percentage figures in laboratory or medical text. Heterogeneous, with token-shape rather than topic as the common factor.

gemma-small-big-fr#9d742ab1.summary: Combines code and markup features — JavaScript snippets, import statements, documentation and copyright blocks, programming keywords, curly brackets — with quotation-mark and quoted-text features, plus a couple of scientific/technical vocabulary detectors.

gemma-small-big-fr#97a15f59.summary: Centered on opposites and disagreement: 'vice versa', 'inverse', 'reverse', words signalling contradiction, mentions of things being contrary, plus equivalence, counterpart and symmetry terminology. Mathematical dual/transpose notation and medical-scientific vocabulary appear as secondary strands.

gemma-small-big-fr#724ccbbc.summary: Code-oriented features (JavaScript and general code snippets, import statements, documentation and copyright blocks, markup keywords, curly brackets) paired with quotation-mark and quoted-span features, plus conjunction detectors. Structural rather than topical.

gemma-small-big-fr#f2b40694.summary: Code and markup features — programming keywords, JavaScript snippets, import statements, documentation and copyright headers, curly brackets — alongside quotation-mark and quoted-text detectors and a few computing/science vocabulary features.

gemma-small-big-fr#97c4ea36.summary: Nearly all members concern contrast: 'vice versa', 'inverse', 'reverse', disagreement and contradiction words, things being opposite or contrary, and equivalence or symmetry terms. Mathematical equation features involving duals and transposes form the main secondary strand.

gemma-small-big-fr#1af5515f.summary: Concentrated on the word 'small' and its neighbours — size and quantity adjectives, dimensions and measurement terms, adjectives for small physical objects — plus a matching 'grand' strand that in late layers drifts into family-relations and ancestry senses of 'grand'. Motor-sport 'Grand Prix' references appear as a homonym artifact.

gemma-small-big-fr#1625a789.summary: Two threads: function words that hedge or qualify — auxiliary verbs, 'latter', 'such', 'apparently', 'somewhat like but not entirely' — and software boilerplate features for 'assembly/using/namespace/license', licensing snippets and markup-heavy text. Fires mainly around the French words 'contraire' and 'est'.

gemma-small-big-fr#43320274.summary: Blends verb features (multilingual verb forms, present/past/auxiliary verbs) with software-code boilerplate ('assembly/using/namespace/license', licensing and import snippets, markup-heavy text), plus a few hedging and argument-closing word detectors.

gemma-small-big-fr#f6f97d9e.summary: A tight cluster about language about language: words enclosed in quotation marks tied to definitions, etymology features, grammar and language terminology, and features for defining concepts — exactly the machinery for a 'the opposite of X is Y' definition frame. Two profanity/slur detectors and one political-figures feature are outliers.

gemma-small-big-fr#b78eb722.summary: Repeated features for software-code boilerplate terms such as 'assembly', 'using', 'namespace' and 'license', licensing and import snippets, and markup-heavy text, with a small number of multilingual verb and single-word ('latter', 'apparently') detectors.

gemma-small-big-fr#3616d2a4.summary: A compact opposition cluster: 'vice versa', 'inverse', 'reverse', words indicating disagreement, mentions of things being opposite or contrary, and scientific symmetry/equivalence terms, with mathematical transpose and dual notation as the recurring secondary flavor.

gemma-small-big-fr#14679b8a.summary: Late-layer features for French words and phrases, informal French conversation and online chat turns, especially French-language discussion of computing, internet and networking topics, plus a few multilingual grammar and code-snippet detectors. These maintain the French output register at the answer position.

gemma-small-big-fr#61debdb8.summary: Members detect French words and phrases, informal French conversation and chat turns, and French-language technical talk about computers and networking, together with multilingual grammatical-structure and question-answer formatting features.

gemma-small-big-fr#3665f80c.summary: Two clear strands: features for the phrase 'other way around' and for the direction or order of items being reversed or inverted, and features for formal legal and research writing about disagreement and court arguments. Comparison and symmetry features tie the two together.

gemma-small-big-fr#3041bc5a.summary: Small cluster combining 'other way around' and reversal-of-order features with legal/research writing features about disagreement, plus comparison and symmetry detectors — the reversal concept the antonym prompt requires.

gemma-small-big-fr#4de00286.summary: Every member is an input-layer quote feature: double-quote tokens, text surrounded by quotation marks, and conversation rendered within quotes, with one member also picking up quotations in legal or political disputes.

gemma-small-big-fr#498843aa.summary: All members detect quoted spans — text inside quotation marks or apostrophes, code quotations and mathematical symbols in quotes, and quoted song or movie titles — at a single early layer.

gemma-small-big-fr#8919d54b.summary: Four near-duplicate features for text inside quotation marks or apostrophes and for quoted code or mathematical symbols; the group is essentially one quoted-string concept.

gemma-small-big-fr#8aad1a82.summary: Pairs features for words that close an argument or mark mathematical and interpersonal relations with features for 'equivalent' and its 'standard' collocations, giving a small equivalence-and-conclusion cluster.

gemma-small-big-fr#defff515.summary: Just two copies of the same feature: words that mark the end of an argument, are mathematical, or indicate an interpersonal connection or relationship.
